$comment: One entry per slice (a small site has one). Criteria are written before the slice is built and are testable by clicking through the preview. The gate thread sets passes from the evaluator's report only; nobody edits check or threshold after the build starts.

slices.goal: A visitor understands the offer and can join the waitlist on a phone

criteria.check: The hero names the offer and the price in the first screen at 390px
Submitting a valid email shows a confirmation screen and the request returns 2xx; an invalid one shows an error
Impressum and Datenschutz are linked from every page and open a filled page, no placeholder text
Largest Contentful Paint on the phone profile
No console errors or failed requests on any page
A visit with utm_source and a waitlist signup each record one analytics event carrying that source
